content: उद्देशः .²1 Pointing to or at, directing; सूर्योद्देशेन तिला दातव्याः <ls>Pt. 2</ls> in the name of. .²2 Mention, specification; सार्धप्रहरद्वयोद्देशे <ls>Pt. 5</ls>; स्वरसंस्कारोद्देशः <ls>Nir.</ls> .²3 Illustration, explanation, exemplification. .²4 Ascertainment, determination, inquiry, investigation, search. .²5 A brief statement or account; एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया <ls>Bg. 10. 40</ls>; <ls>Mb. 8. 69. 54</ls>. .²6 Assignment, allotment. .²7 Stipulation, bargain. .²8 Object, motive; कृतोद्देशः स बीभत्सुः <ls>Mb. 3. 158. 3</ls>. .²9 A spot, region, place; अहो प्रवातसुभगोयमुद्देशः <ls>Ś. 3</ls>; <ls>M. 3</ls>; वन˚ a part of the forest. .²10 Upper region, high position. .²11 (In <ab>phil.</ab>) The enunciation of a thing by its name (which is to be further discussed and explained), the other two processes being लक्षण and परीक्षा.
